Let me declare H1: Directional keys move the orange/blue target element, not the player. RIGHT moves it right. Need to test other directions.
Actually, let me reconsider. The DOWN actions changed nodes 16, 17 (the HUD bar) but NOT nodes 10, 11 (the target). The RIGHT action changed nodes 10, 11 (the target) AND nodes 16, 17 (the HUD bar). So:
- DOWN: only changes HUD bar
- RIGHT: changes HUD bar AND moves target right
This is strange. Why would DOWN only affect the HUD but RIGHT affects both? Unless... the target can only move in certain directions based on the maze layout?
Wait, let me reconsider. Maybe the target DOES move with DOWN, but it's blocked by the maze walls. Let me check the initial target position and see if there's space below it.
Initial target position:
- Node 10 (O): rows 45-46, cols 34-38
- Node 11 (b): rows 47-49, cols 34-38
The blue part extends to row 49. Looking at the maze boundary, the bottom of the maze is around row 49-50. So the target is at the bottom of the maze and can't move further down. That's why DOWN doesn't move it!
Similarly, the target might be blocked from moving in other directions by maze walls. RIGHT worked because there was space to the right.
